★Request
Costume: Tanino Gimlet (Summer Tracksuit) Show

...I have received your words.
You are certain of my talent—then the first trial is cleared.

With that kind of speed, if she pushes forward on the mile route,
she'll surely achieve something incredible...!
Haah, haah...! Gh...!
Hmph. Two.
ORAAGHHHHHHHHHH!!

(It's cut off.
—Hmph...! How amusing! Then I shall carve my way through on my own!)

That closing burst in the final 100 meters to seize 3rd place...!
If she hadn't been boxed in, it would've been her absolute victory!

However, that is merely the first trial.
...Look. How many do you see?

That alone is what we must aim for.
For it must never be the Asphodel Meadows.

(Is this the Labyrinth of Einherjar?!
The Ariadne's thread I must follow is—)

Ooh! She doesn't have a dedicated trainer yet, right?
I bet a lot of trainers are eyeing her...
—What a monstrous closing drive! Tanino Gimlet finishes 3rd!

With that, she suddenly held up one finger.
Without understanding why, I answered honestly for the moment.

...Tanino Gimlet is in trouble. She's completely boxed in,
with no way out. If only she could find an opening...

One day, upon hearing a rumor that Tanino Gimlet
would be running in an exhibition race, I decided to go watch.

What a truly fitting day!
Into the heavens, into the earth, and into those eyes of yours, engrave it! My raw impulse!
Final 100 meters, Tanino Gimlet is finally charging in!
—Is the summit of Mount Elbrus still so distant...?!

And so we shall see—both you, and I.
Whether an Elysium truly awaits at the edge of this ocean.

Tanino Gimlet might seem eccentric, but her skill is the real deal.
I heard she turned a club team around back in the day, or something like that.

"You possess an extraordinary talent. With that tremendous
speed, you could achieve glorious success on the mile route."

It seemed to be a personal journal
chronicling Tanino Gimlet's life.

She might be an eccentric Umamusume, but everyone respected her
racing abilities. —And with that, the exhibition race began!

Tanino Gimlet settles into the back of the pack,
—and now, they head into the 4th corner!

To narrow possibilities down to a single one.
You are still—lacking.
I refuse.

"You possess an extraordinary talent. With that tremendous
speed, you could achieve glorious success on the mile route."

"Do you wish to know the tale of Tanino Gimlet?
The eternal story that has flowed unbroken since that tender childhood day—"

—First, I shall entrust this to you.
Follow the words into the past, and behold the future...!

Then there is but one thing to do.
I shall add a twist to you myself.
She may have missed the win, but—
Looks like she couldn't reach the lead after all. That's gotta be frustrating...!

Breaking free, Tanino Gimlet accelerated with a roar.
She rapidly closed the distance, catching up to the lead pack in an instant, but—

—Broad daylight.
Ah, a fleeting wind strokes my cheek!

She doesn't have a dedicated trainer yet, which means that
wasn't refined skill—it was her raw, God-given talent.

Swept up in excitement, I rushed out of the stands
and ran down to the turf to scout her. However—
And they're off for the 1600-meter turf race!

Rounding the 4th corner into the home stretch!
Still buried in the pack! Tanino Gimlet is far back in the field!
And so, when I returned to the dorm and opened the letter she handed me—
